gloss: informal dress; semi-formal attire; simplified outfit

definitions.gloss: informal dress; semi-formal attire; simplified outfit
definitions.explanation: Clothing that is less formal than full formal dress but still appropriate for the occasion. Used when an event or situation does not require full ceremonial or business attire.

examples.japanese: {略装|りゃくそう}でお{越|こ}しください。
{式|しき}は{略装|りゃくそう}でも{構|かま}いません。
examples.english: Semi-formal dress is fine for the ceremony.

examples.japanese: {招待状|しょうたいじょう}に「{略装|りゃくそう}にて」と{書|か}いてあったので、スーツにネクタイなしで{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: The invitation said 'semi-formal attire,' so I attended in a suit without a tie.

notes:
Composed of {略|りゃく} (abbreviation; simplification) and {装|そう} (clothing; outfit). Commonly appears on invitations and event notices as a dress code indicator. In Japanese etiquette, {略装|りゃくそう} means the attendee need not wear the most formal version of attire — for men, this typically means a suit without a tie; for women, a smart outfit that is not a full formal gown.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {略装|りゃくそう}でお{越|こ}しください: please come in informal attire
- {略装|りゃくそう}にて: in informal dress (written on invitations)
- {略装|りゃくそう}で{参加|さんか}する: to attend in semi-formal attire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正装|せいそう}: full formal dress — the most formal level of attire for ceremonies
- {平服|へいふく}: everyday clothes; informal dress — often appears on invitations and can cause confusion since it actually means 'smart casual' rather than truly casual wear
- カジュアル: casual — the most relaxed dress code, borrowed from English
